Q1: 1,3-Dinitrobenzene exhibits a comprehensive hazard profile, with Tier 1 classifications across multiple categories including carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, and reproductive hazards (CMR), environmental (ENV), inhalation (IHL), oral (ORL), dermal and eye (SKN), and organ and systemic (OGN) hazards. It is also identified as a Tier 2 endocrine disruptor (EDC), indicating an expanded perspective on its potential to interfere with the endocrine system.

It is also recognized as a potential endocrine disruptor on the TEDX list and is subject to oversight under the Clean Water Act and EPA's Drinking Water Standard.
